propositions: Completion verifier receives only fenced ticket context without file contents, forcing 84-158 agentic file-fetch requests per run (4-6s each, dominated by round-trips not tokens), with 67-82% of reads overlapping declared file_impact.

Pre-fetch file_impact contents and referencing-commit diffs into the verifier's context as a bounded, labelled section, cache-read via automatic prefix caching; graph=False close-path prefetches only own file_impact (no subtree), graph=True deep-review prefetches subtree-union ranked by cross-descendant frequency.

Prefetch is opt-in via assemble_context parameter (default None for generic review callers to preserve byte-identity); files over 500 lines skeleton-compressed before truncation at 30k-token aggregate cap; per-file manifest records full|skeleton mode.
Recovery successors inherit prefetch automatically via shared assembled ticket_context; prefetch bytes counted in physical_context_ceiling validation so oversize prefetch trims rather than raising.

Trusted anti-anchoring guidance added to completion_verifier.md static prefix (before volatile marker) co-located with prefetch data; directs verifier to rely on full bodies directly, re-read only skeleton-marked files.

Live Bedrock A/B validates >=20% request reduction (f6fc 56%, e6a0 30%) with equal verdict class; close-path own-file_impact coverage 29-33% of baseline distinct reads; 23 new unit tests validate ranking, clamping, manifest, entrypoint boundaries, cache accounting, and tool surface unchanged.
